absences: Oklo: no Chief Commercial Officer or Chief Revenue Officer role found in the April 2026 DEF 14A or the July 2026 8-K executive-appointment list -- the 9 confirmed executive officers are CEO, COO, CFO, Chief Legal and Strategy Officer, Chief Product Officer, Chief of Staff, General Counsel, SVP Engineering, and VP Accounting/Controller.

Oklo: the widely-reported '$64-73/MWh' LCOE figure and the '~$145 million first 50 MW powerhouse' figure could not be verified verbatim in any primary Oklo document I could fetch -- oklo.com (investor-relations and newsroom) returns 403 to automated fetches, and the SEC-filed Q2 2024 8-K shareholder-letter exhibit renders its charts as JPG images with no extractable text layer, so the numbers (reported by Utility Dive as coming from a since-unfetchable 'Oklo-Inc-Q2-2024-Company-Update-Presentation-August-2024.pdf') could not be independently confirmed and were dropped rather than quoted secondhand.

Oklo: same issue for the DOE clean-firm cost-comparison bands (gas w/ CCS $63-99/MWh, non-Oklo advanced nuclear $66-109/MWh, renewables+storage $69-119/MWh) -- confirmed to exist via Utility Dive's direct reporting on Oklo's August 2024 investor presentation, but the primary PDF itself was not independently fetchable, so no quote record was created for it.

Oklo: Diamondback Energy LOI (50 MW, signed April 2024) predates the research window and was not mentioned in any of the Q2 2024, Q3 2025, Q4 2025, Q1 2026, or Q2 2026 earnings-call transcripts I fetched -- no in-window reaffirmation found, suggesting the relationship has gone quiet since the original announcement.

Oklo: no earnings-call mention of the Switch 12 GW master power agreement with specific dollar or capacity detail beyond the original December 2024 announcement; could not find an in-window CEO/CFO quote elaborating on Switch specifically (only a passing 'Switch and Meta' mention in the Q1 2026 call).

Last Energy: no CFO, COO, or General Counsel name could be confirmed against a fetchable primary source. Secondary aggregators (ZoomInfo, Equilar) name Adam Wyrick as CFO and cite Eric Johannessen/Anton van Saase as General Counsel at different points, but none of these pages were fetchable (403 or no bio content), so none were added as leader records.

Last Energy: the widely-cited '24 units sold in the UK for GBP2.4bn' (part of a 34-unit/$18.9bn Poland+UK figure) is dated to a March 29, 2023 announcement (confirmed via ANS Nuclear Newswire), which predates the research window. No in-window restatement of that specific aggregate figure was found -- the only in-window UK figures are project-specific (4 units / GBP300m at Llynfi, South Wales, announced October 2024).

Last Energy: found the company's own FAQ/technology pages stating the PWR-20 uses 'sub-5% low enriched uranium fuel' (i.e., no HALEU required at all), but this is unattributed marketing copy, not a named speaker's verbatim quote, so it was not added as a quotes record despite being a significant supply-chain finding -- see summary.

leaders.name: Jacob DeWitte
leaders.title: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
leaders.background: Co-founded Legacy Oklo in July 2013 and served as its CEO and a board member until the May 2024 business combination with AltC Acquisition Corp, becoming CEO and a director of the public Oklo Inc.; added Chairman of the Board in April 2025. Holds a Ph.D. and S.M. in Nuclear Engineering from MIT (studied nuclear engineering 2004-2014); prior internships at Sandia National Laboratories, Urenco Limited, GE, and the U.S. Naval Nuclear Laboratory.
leaders.why_they_matter: Founder-CEO who has led Oklo continuously since 2013, now steering its public-company commercialization push (Aurora powerhouse, hyperscaler deals, DOE relationships).
